founding_decisions.title: Keep one lending consistency boundary with explicit adapter ports
founding_decisions.question: Which model owns reservation decisions, state transitions and durable handover?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: One Lending bounded context owns a reservation module with proportional Core logic and explicit persistence/effect ports.
alternatives: Separate each HTTP action into an unrelated context.
Couple policy, HTTP and storage in one implementation.
founding_decisions.rationale: The state, language, ownership and consistency boundary coincide; adapters can vary without changing policy.
consequences: The feature proves policy ordering, state transitions, runtime resolution and adapter replacement.
Immutable Forms are produced during build and admitted/rendered through public released APIs.
Architecture creates a Proposed founding ADR and closes actual early compatibility risks before review.
